$comment: Seeded from the frozen v1 discovery schema at the RFC 0266 §C cut-over (byte-equal to the 2.49.12 derivation); v2-owned since, edited by hand.

dimensions.description: Which budget dimensions the host actually enforces (truthful — advertise only what it honors). A consumer MUST tolerate any subset.

enforce.description: `hard`: exhaustion emits `cap.breached` + stops the run. `advisory`: emits the events but MUST NOT stop the run (honest advertisement of observe-only).

onExhaustion.description: RFC 0231. The `BudgetPolicy.onExhaustion` values the host serves under `enforce: "hard"`. Exact when present. Absent: both. A value not listed is refused `422 capability_not_provided` at create, never applied as another behaviour and never ignored. A consumer ignores it under `enforce: "advisory"`.

scopes.description: Which budget scopes the host honors (§B). Absent ⇒ at least `run`.
